data.long_meaning: The Old High German name Irwino was composed of the elements irw, meaning 'fern' or 'ruler', and wino, meaning 'friend' or 'forest' or 'wood'. The name Irv is derived from this Germanic name. It was popularized in the English-speaking world due to the influence of the Anglo-Saxon culture.
